dataset.note: Prepared from test-data.npz (images/labels); first 1000 labelled images.

limitations: Only trusted local .joblib classifiers are supported in this stage.
Uploaded files are processed in memory and are not persisted.
Tree SHAP is preferred for compatible trees; other probabilistic classifiers use pixel occlusion.

explanations.interpretation: Red pixels support the displayed predicted class and blue pixels oppose it. Each map is normalized separately, so compare spatial patterns rather than color magnitude. Contributions are associations, not causal effects.
